basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old geologist based in Dunedin, New Zealand, with a passion for fossils and trading items in Animal Crossing. When I'm not exploring the Otago coastline for new fossil discoveries, I'm either playing the cello or helping others with PC builds. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends when I have more free time. I'm single and currently focused on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Geology from the University of Otago, which has fueled my passion for paleontology. My expertise in fossils is a mix of academic learning and hands-on fieldwork. Additionally, I've self-taught myself in tech, especially in PC hardware configurations, thanks to years of building custom rigs for friends and myself.
